research_contract.target: Use outcome-independent metadata to widen the opened development Agent panel while preserving a project-sealed Agent holdout panel.
research_contract.primary_reason: The three-Agent joint response candidate passed nominal development gates but failed temporal-null and leave-one-Agent audits; more Agent mechanisms are needed to separate task-level signal from panel-specific coincidences.
non_solutions: selecting submissions from leaderboard scores or result contents
opening every eligible result before a candidate exists
reactivating the retired joint_markov_match candidate from a favorable replication
using held-out Agent outcomes as Selector features
changing runtime to aggregate Tasks across repositories

source.result_normalization: resolved is pass; every other Task in the exact 500-Task denominator is fail

inventory_rule.model_openness: not an inclusion criterion; Agent-mechanism diversity is the research variable and official per-Task outcomes are the evidence input
inventory_rule.allocation: Group the 14 project-sealed submissions by mechanism family, sort each family by submission path, and alternate development then holdout. Put a singleton family in development.

preallocation_exclusions.reason: Result content was inspected during earlier route feasibility, so it is not project-sealed evidence.

phase_contract.first_open: Open only the eight development result blobs. Before using them to design another Selector, evaluate the frozen joint_markov_match memberships learned from the original three-Agent panel against these eight Agents and record the one-shot result.
phase_contract.replication_interpretation: The retired candidate cannot be promoted or reactivated. The result only measures whether the mechanism's selected Tasks transfer to an outcome-independent Agent panel.
phase_contract.development_after_replication: After the one-shot result is committed, the eight outcomes join the three existing outcomes as an eleven-Agent opened development panel.
holdout_open_gate: a new mechanism and all of its constants are frozen before holdout outcomes are opened
the candidate passes the existing wide, repository-direction, leave-one-repository, deep, random-calibration, and history-match development gates
the candidate passes a temporal-null audit below 0.10
leave-one-Agent evaluation over the eleven-Agent development panel has a negative wide macro difference and is favorable for at least eight of eleven Agents
phase_contract.holdout_use: The six held-out Agents may evaluate a frozen candidate once. They never become Selector inputs for that evaluation.

temporal_availability.one_shot_replication: Reuse the already-frozen first-wave memberships and label their cross-repository fits as retrospective because those fits could consume later-created Tasks from other repositories.
temporal_availability.new_candidate_rule: At each target Origin, a cross-repository fit may consume only Tasks whose created_at is no later than the final Task in the target history. A source Origin is eligible as an analog only when its full future block is also available by that cutoff.
temporal_availability.empty_prior_rule: If no other repository supplies two available Tasks, use only the algorithm's frozen symmetric prior; do not borrow later Tasks.
temporal_availability.reason: Repository holdout prevents target-repository leakage but is not a substitute for rolling calendar-time availability.

claim_boundary: All result files are already public, so project-sealed means their per-Task contents have not been inspected in this research process. This is stronger than opened-data development but weaker than a private prospective benchmark.

authority.allowed_network_reads_before_plan_commit: metadata files and Git object identities only
authority.allowed_network_reads_after_plan_commit: the eight development result blobs only
authority.forbidden_network_reads: the six holdout result blobs until the frozen holdout gate is met
authority.raw_result_policy: Keep result files under ignored output paths; commit only plans, compact normalized summaries, and digests.
